current_app_protection: Current app route chain cannot be archived.
conflict_policy: If archive plan conflicts with route/safety/privacy proof, archive is blocked.
archive_stages: ARCHIVE_STAGE_4 hold as archived during cooling period

hard_rules: Archive is reversible; delete is last resort.
If a file has uncertainty, archive it instead of deleting it.
No direct archive from main without proposal and tests.
Archive permission remains false until a proposal is approved.
